searchDocs.title: EZProfileStore
searchDocs.content: EZProfileStore EZProfileStore wraps ProfileStore with a small server API for profile lifecycle, ordered schema migrations, mocks, historical rollbacks, and replicated mutations, plus a client API for reading a Fusion-backed local mirror. Start with the README for installation and examples, then use the API pages for method-level details generated from the Moonwave comments in src/.

searchDocs.title: Mutate​
searchDocs.content: </> Server:Mutate( player: Player , transform: (data: {[any]: any}) → ...boolean ) → boolean-- true if the draft was committed. Edits a draft copy of the player's data and commits it all-or-nothing. The transform must not yield. If it errors, returns false, produces unsavable values, or fails config.validate, live data is untouched. Otherwise the draft is diffed against live data and only the changed paths are written and replicated. store:Mutate(player, function(data) if data.Coins < 100 then return false end data.Coins -= 100 table.insert(data.Inventory, "Sword") end)

searchDocs.title: MutateMany​
searchDocs.content: </> Server:MutateMany( players: {Player }, transform: (drafts: {[Player ]: {[any]: any}}) → ...boolean ) → boolean-- true if every draft was committed. Like Mutate, but commits drafts for several loaded players together or not at all. Use it for trades so a failed check cannot leave one side changed. ProfileStore still saves each profile independently, so this is atomic in memory, not across a server crash.

searchDocs.title: SendMessageAsync​
searchDocs.content: This is a yielding function. When called, it will pause the Lua thread that called the function until a result is ready to be returned, without interrupting other scripts. Yields </> Server:SendMessageAsync( target: Target, message: {[any]: any} ) → boolean Sends a message to a profile, online or offline, via ProfileStore:MessageAsync. Useful for gifts and admin grants; handle it with OnMessage.

searchDocs.title: OnMessage​
searchDocs.content: </> Server:OnMessage(handler: MessageHandler) → () → ()-- Disconnects the handler. Handles messages for loaded profiles, including ones already waiting. Call processed after applying a message (usually with Mutate) so it is not delivered again. store:OnMessage(function(player, message, processed) if message.type == "Gift" and store:Mutate(player, function(data) data.Coins += message.coins end) then processed() end end)
